name: AMEE 2027
organizer: AMEE, An International Association for Health Professions Education
description: AMEE, An International Association for Health Professions Education, holds its 2027 annual conference in Helsinki, Finland. The conference covers research and practice in medical and health professions education.

sources.note: Confirms dates (28 August to 1 September 2027) and Helsinki as the host city
Confirms the 2026 conference (Vienna) already concluded, with online participation offered alongside in-person

notes: Format is listed as hybrid based on the 2026 conference offering both in-person (Vienna) and online participation; this has not been explicitly restated yet for 2027. No 2027 abstract or registration deadlines are published yet.
